text:
```yaml
name: Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  release:
    permissions:
      contents: write
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Git Ops
        uses: jmanhype/git-ops@v1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Release Please
        uses: googleapis/release-please-action@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          release-type: elixir
          bump-minor-pre-major: true
          bump-patch-for-minor-pre-major: true
```
